REGIONAL AMBULANCE SERVICE — WORKING TIME RULE WT-2 AND ROSTER EXTRACT (PARAMEDIC T. VOLKOV)

WT-2 Daily rest: between the end of one shift and the start of the next, a paramedic must have at least 11 consecutive hours of rest, measured in actual elapsed time. A rest period of exactly 11 hours complies. Each rest period shorter than 11 hours counts as one violation.
Clock change: on Sunday 25 October 2026 at 03:00 local summer time (CEST, UTC+2), clocks go back to 02:00 local winter time (CET, UTC+1). The roster system shows local wall-clock times only.

Roster (local times):
S1 Wed 21 Oct 13:00 – 21:00
S2 Thu 22 Oct 07:30 – 15:30
S3 Fri 23 Oct 06:00 – 14:00
S4 Sat 24 Oct 10:00 – 18:00
S5 Sun 25 Oct 04:30 – 12:30
S6 Sun 25 Oct 23:30 – Mon 26 Oct 07:30
S7 Mon 26 Oct 18:30 – Tue 27 Oct 02:30
S8 Tue 27 Oct 13:30 – 21:30
Other WT-2 provisions (for information): maximum shift length 12 hours; at least one 24-hour rest in every 7 days; night-shift allowance for hours between 23:00 and 06:00 local time.
Rest periods are measured from the rostered end of one shift to the rostered start of the next; overruns are recorded separately and are not part of this review.
Union rep's note: "By the roster clock I see four problem rests: S1→S2, S4→S5, and S5→S6 and S6→S7, which are both only 11 hours — so four violations."

decision.instructions: How many WT-2 daily-rest violations does this roster contain? (0 = none, 1 = one, 2 = two, 3 = three or more.)
